Robert Greifeld | Robert Greifeld (born 1957) is an American businessman and is the chairman of Nasdaq, the largest electronic screen-based equity securities market in the United States. Greifeld focused the NASDAQ-OMX mission on being the premier U.S equities market, leveraging NASDAQ-OMX's fundamental market structure advantage.
Intercontinental Real Estate Corporation | The Intercontinental Real Estate Corporation is a SEC Registered Investment Adviser that manages private equity real estate investments and provides real estate services for domestic and international clients. The Silverfern Group | The Silverfern Group, a multi-asset class investment management firm making direct investments in middle market private equity, real estate and private debt globally, was founded in 2001.

Joaquin Avila | Joaquin Avila is Managing Director of the global private equity firm, Carlyle Group, where he is responsible for researching and discovering opportunities in the field of buyout investments.
